newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Randstad to appoint Zwarts as new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Randstad to appoint Zwarts as new CEO.

text.p: Dutch temporary employment and services group Randstad Holding NV said on Monday Hans Zwarts will be appointed as its chief executive officer in next year's general meeting of shareholders.
He will succeed Randstad founder Frits Goldschmeding who will step down from the management board in 1998 after reaching the statutory retirement age.

Zwarts will become a member of the Randstad management board on September 1, 1997, in the function of vice-president. He is currently a member of the executive committee of ING Nederland, the Dutch arm of financial services group ING.
